name: @avatark/living-systems-runtime
description: Executes the Living Systems causal simulation (world clock, season transition, environmental causality, entity lifecycle, encounter resolution, world-snapshot resolution) and provides reference in-memory repositories. Host-neutral: authors no world content, hardcodes no franchise behavior.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/worldClock.test.ts src/causalEnvironment.test.ts src/seasonTransition.test.ts src/entityLifecycle.test.ts src/encounterResolution.test.ts src/snapshotResolver.test.ts src/simulation.test.ts src/inMemoryRepositories.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
